title: Event Extraction Engine — 事件抽取引擎
description: Implement structured event extraction from unstructured Chinese financial text. The engine MUST classify event types (EARNINGS_FORECAST, MERGER_ACQUISITION, EQUITY_CHANGE, POLICY_CHANGE, DIVIDEND), extract trigger phrases with character offsets, identify participants, and map to P3 EventType taxonomy. Depends on F-041 NER Engine for entity recognition.

criteria: 5 event types extracted: [EARNINGS_FORECAST, MERGER_ACQUISITION, EQUITY_CHANGE, POLICY_CHANGE, DIVIDEND]
EventExtractionResult frozen dataclass with 2 fields: [events tuple, processing_time_ms]
ExtractedEvent frozen dataclass with 7 fields: [event_type, trigger_phrase, participants, amount, date, confidence, entity_spans]
Trigger phrase extraction with character offsets
14+ unit tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_event_extractor.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True pattern
convergence.definition_of_done: Event extractor classifies 5 event types from Chinese financial text with trigger phrases and entity linking

files.change: EventExtractor class with extract() method, event type classification, trigger phrase extraction

implementation.title: Create event trigger patterns
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/event_patterns.py with 30+ trigger patterns for 5 event types. Each event type has 6+ trigger phrases: EARNINGS_FORECAST (预计/业绩预增/业绩预亏/扭亏为盈), MERGER_ACQUISITION (收购/合并/并购/重组), EQUITY_CHANGE (增持/减持/回购/质押), POLICY_CHANGE (发布/实施/调整/修改), DIVIDEND (分红/派息/高送转).
modification_points: Create 1 new file with 30+ trigger patterns
logic_flow: Define EVENT_TRIGGER_PATTERNS dict mapping event_type→list of (pattern, groups) tuples
Each pattern captures trigger phrase + optional amount/date/parties

implementation.title: Implement EventExtractor
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/event_extractor.py with EventExtractor.extract(text: TextDocument) -> EventExtractionResult. Pipeline: (1) TextPreprocessor, (2) NEREngine for entity recognition, (3) Pattern matching for event triggers, (4) Event type classification, (5) Detail extraction (amount, date, parties), (6) Map to P3 EventType.
